title: Make HRB compute-role, non-display, live identity, NUMA locality, CUDA and no-fallback evidence mandatory for Human Motion current-host admission
rationale: Human Motion is a compute workload and SHALL consume an HRB compute-role placement instead of selecting an accelerator independently.
A display/UI accelerator SHALL NOT satisfy production Human Motion execution admission.
Accelerator identity SHALL be live UUID plus PCI BDF; runtime ordinal is ephemeral and non-authoritative.
CPU, memory and accelerator locality SHALL be proven as one HRB placement using live NUMA topology.
Production evidence SHALL prove CUDA execution on the HRB-selected accelerator and SHALL fail on CPU or cross-accelerator fallback.
Concrete accelerator SKU, VRAM, fixed PCI BDF, NUMA node and CUDA ordinal remain forbidden portable baseline constants.
